lipophilicity.sql: SELECT act.molregno, act.standard_value, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = act.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'LogD' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN -5 AND 10 AND a.description LIKE '%7.4%' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL

solubility.sql: SELECT act.molregno, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cp.full_mwt, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities act JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = act.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON cp.molregno = act.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'Solubility' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND act.standard_units IN ('nM', 'ug.mL-1') AND cp.full_mwt IS NOT NULL AND cp.full_mwt > 0 AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL

bbb_martins.reason: ChEMBL 36 carries only a few hundred blood-brain-barrier distribution activity rows across incompatible standard_types; no ChEMBL-derived BBB training pool of usable size exists. S1b arm A is therefore NOT RUN for BBB-Martins; arm B (train on the benchmark's own train_val split) still runs.
